natural_and_sots_ssim: RGB Gaussian window 11x11, sigma 1.5, valid region.
rrshid_ssim: RGB Uniform11, zero padding; separate metric identity from Gaussian11.
sample_keys: Dataset-scoped pair_key identifiers are retained, not local filesystem paths. source_name is a dataset-relative image name.
hash_scope: Image hashes are inherited from source records; CSV/JSON/DOCX source file hashes were computed in this export. Raw image pixels were not opened or rehashed.
statuses: Retained evidence/status labels are not promoted into a new formal validation claim.
sample_relationships: Natural-image comparisons contain 11 methods on the same 185 pairs (30 I-HAZE, 45 O-HAZE, 55 Dense-Haze, 55 NH-HAZE); these are 2035 measurements, not 2035 independent scenes.
Table V contains only ODCR-Mamba on 500 indoor and 500 outdoor SOTS pairs. No additional SOTS subset comparison is included.
The 304 RRSHID fused-output rows also occur among the 912 branch rows; the three branches use the same 304 pairs and cannot be counted as independent samples.
coverage_limit: The package contains all eight main-table displays and full available aggregate scalar precision. Per-image records are provided only for the listed exports; external-method RRSHID per-image records and per-image records for Tables VI/VII are not included. This package does not claim complete raw-data or training reproducibility.
